scope: Campbell (E Campbell Ave) and Fremont (Fremont Blvd) - plus three cross-checks that add data to rows already in the master
method: Dedupe first: Kiya Sushi, Tai Pan BBQ Express and Country Way are already mastered (L477, L478, L463) so their fresh captures are filed as cross-checks instead of duplicate rows. Two genuinely new Campbell businesses are added; two closed/ghost-kitchen listings are rejected.

entries.name: Square Pie Guys

lunch_special.name: No published lunch special - an 11:30 AM open covers the whole lunch window at regular prices
lunch_special.window: 11:30 AM - 8:30 / 9:00 / 9:30 / 10:30 PM depending on which capture is used (see flag)
lunch_special.includes: Own site squarepieguys.com. Business description on Yelp: 'modern Detroit Style Pizza with a chef-driven twist ... shareable Detroit Style Pizzas, vegan options, and comfort food classics like Buffalo Wings'. No printed lunch price captured.

entries.hours_tuesday: 11:30 AM - 9:00 PM (newest capture; three other captures give 8:30, 9:30 PM)
entries.days_open: Four captures of the same business, four different closing patterns: Sept 2026 Mon-Sun 11:30 AM - 9:00 PM; May 2026 Mon-Thu and Sun 11:30 AM - 9:30 PM with Fri-Sat to 10:30 PM; April 2026 Mon-Thu and Sun 11:30 AM - 8:30 PM with Fri-Sat to 9:30 PM. All agree on the 11:30 AM open every day.

fits_return_bus.note: E Campbell Ave, Campbell - roughly 7 miles from the destination.

sources.label: Yelp business page (Sept 2026) - 501 E Campbell Ave, Campbell CA 95008, (408) 409-5955, Mon-Sun 11:30 am-9:00 pm, website squarepieguys.com, 4.4 (243 reviews), 'Updated 2 months ago', plus the Detroit-style-pizza business description
May 2026 capture of a second Yelp slug for the same address - Mon-Thu and Sun 11:30 am-9:30 pm, Fri-Sat 11:30 am-10:30 pm, 'Updated a few days ago', 4.4 (219 reviews)
April 2026 capture - Mon-Thu and Sun 11:30 am-8:30 pm, Fri-Sat 11:30 am-9:30 pm, 4.4 (197 reviews)

flags: Two problems at once. (1) Closing time has drifted across 2026 captures (8:30 -> 9:00 -> 9:30 -> 10:30 PM variants) so only the 11:30 AM open is safe to plan on. (2) The business exists under TWO different Yelp slugs - 'square-pie-guys-campbell-campbell' and 'square-pie-guys-campbell-4' - with separate review counts (243 vs 219) for one physical address, which inflates apparent review volume.

rejected.name: Square Pie Guys (Local Kitchens - Campbell)

rejected.reason: PERMANENTLY CLOSED ghost-kitchen listing - the Yelp page title reads 'SQUARE PIE GUYS - CLOSED - Updated July 2026'. It is a separate listing from the real brick-and-mortar at 501 E Campbell Ave: different address, a San Francisco (415) 992-8206 phone, 'Located in: Local Kitchens-Campbell', and a link to localkitchens.com/order/store/. Its hours were printed as 11:00 am - 12:00 am seven days a week, which would have looked like an ideal all-day lunch option if taken at face value. Rejected so it cannot be confused with the live Campbell location.

cross_checks.what_the_fresh_capture_says: The restaurant's OWN ordering site publishes a Lunch Special definition: 'Lunch Special, 11 am - 3 pm, Served with miso soup, green salad, white rice, 4 pieces California roll, two pieces gzyoa. Lunch items are only viewable on this page during lunch ordering hours.' That last sentence is why no price could be captured - the items and prices are hidden outside 11 am-3 pm. Separately, a Yelp review states 'The trio roll lunch special is a good deal for 14.99 and it comes...' with free matcha ice cream; because $14.99 is reviewer-reported rather than printed on the official menu, it stays out of the price columns. IMPORTANT CONTRADICTION: the official lunch window runs to 3:00 PM but the official JSON-LD hours close the restaurant at 2:30 PM Mon-Thu (11:00-14:30 then 16:30-21:00), so the advertised lunch special cannot be served for its final half hour on weekdays. Address 36488 Fremont Blvd, Fremont CA 94536, phone (510) 894-1112, geo 37.562857/-122.0145387, priceRange $$, kiyasushifremont.com. A third source (beyondmenu) lists the weekday dinner block as 5:00 PM-9:30 PM rather than 4:30 PM-9:00 PM.

cross_checks.master_name: Tai Pan Dim Sum (Tai Pan BBQ Express), Fremont
cross_checks.what_the_fresh_capture_says: Fresh September 2026 capture confirms 39486 Fremont Blvd, Fremont CA 94538, (510) 739-1868, and daily 10:00 AM - 7:00 PM seven days a week (no afternoon break), 3.7 with 452-456 reviews. Two diner-sourced deal details are now on record but neither is on an official menu: 'The sesame balls 5 for $1 are great' and 'Their daily specials are such a good deal'. One photo on the page is literally captioned 'prices'. Recommend keeping hours as-is and adding the 10:00 AM open plus the sesame-ball deal as a flagged lead.

cross_checks.what_the_fresh_capture_says: A Fremont 'Food Deals' capture (April 2026) prints a specific diner claim worth recording against L463: 'I ordered the Bacon Burger lunch special. It was a great deal for $7.95.' The listing shows 4.0 (2.9k reviews), $$ and 'Closed until 7:00 AM', i.e. a breakfast-lunch diner open early. The $7.95 figure is reviewer-reported, not from an official menu, so it must not be moved into a price column without a menu capture.
